name: Medium steel knee guards
description: A pair of thin domed steel cups that strap over the knees, with a small wing to guard the side of the joint. Light enough to wear over mail or greaves.
notes: Laid side by side, convex side up: each guard is a domed steel cup over the joint with a curved lame above and below it, a round wing on the outer side and two buckled leather straps behind. Each 200 mm from top to foot and 190 mm across the wing. CHECK VOLUME: the model's box is the pair laid out flat with their straps spread, while the reference volume is the pair stacked. Encumbrance follows the reference; warmth is a guess for a bare plate. Size variants share the model. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored. Medium steel in `steel-grey`; the tempered pair shares this model.
